sara (docs): FYI — the API ref for POST /v1/rewrite shows example responses with "content" in the items, but the JS SDK unit tests and a few internal snippets still expect "text". Customer reported a KeyError when parsing the page curl sample.

john (eng-runtime): Hmm — runtime historically returned "text" but a serializer change landed last month that normalizes output to "content". We didn't coordinate the SDK/docs update. We can add a compatibility shim, but I'd prefer docs+SDK update first.

kim (sdk): Can you paste the exact example from the docs page so I can update the Node snippet to be defensive?

sara (docs): Example currently on the page: 
```json
{
  "outputs": [
    {"content": "Short rewrite of the paragraph."}
  ]
}
```
Proposed docs change: show both shapes (legacy `text` and new `content`) and add a short migration note. I'll draft a PR with a combined example and a banner: "Note: response field renamed from `text` -> `content` on 2026-02-03; SDKs should accept either."

kim (sdk): OK. I'll submit a tiny patch to the JS SDK to accept `o.content ?? o.text` and add a unit test. Also update the README snippet to use the nullish coalescing for clarity.

john (eng-runtime): I agree — avoid runtime hacks for now. Docs + SDK patch is safer and lets us surface the change to customers. If we see too many support hits, we can consider a temporary proxy.

deploy-bot: Automation: docs PR opened by sara -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/900 (CI: docs-lint \u2705, link-check: pending). SDK PR opened by kim -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/512 (CI: unit-tests failing, will rerun).

kim (sdk): Pushed tests locally, passing. Pushed fix to sdk-js#512. The snippet change is one line: `console.log(o.content ?? o.text)` and a test that validates both keys.

sara (docs): I'll add the combined JSON example and a curl example using the new `content` key plus an explicit legacy snippet showing `text`. Also adding a migration note with the date/version and a link to sdk-js#512.

john (eng-runtime): Reviewed the SDK change, lgtm. Please merge when docs CI green. I'll skim support channels for fallout tomorrow.

sara (docs): Merged docs PR after link-check passed. Deployed to staging; will promote to prod after SDK release. :white_check_mark:

kim (sdk): SDK PR merged and published as patch. Release notes: "sdk-js 2.3.1: accept `content` or `text` in rewrite outputs (migration safe)."

john (eng-runtime): Thanks. I'll mark the serializer change in the release notes and close the follow-up internal ticket.

sara (docs): Closing thread. If anyone spots remaining samples showing only `text`, ping me and I'll scrub the site. :mag:
